summary: Compact, theme-aware settings context card with inline product-area and profile menu triggers.
useWhen: A settings workspace needs to show and change both its product area and the organization or profile being managed.
avoidWhen: The content is a reporting period and metrics summary; use CardOverview.
The card edits settings in place; use CardSetting.
accessibility: Both scope values are native buttons with popup relationships and controlled expanded state.
Use the emitted native anchor for menu placement and focus return.
An empty informational profiles popup uses dialog semantics.
The shared text-action recipe supplies brand foreground, hover underline, and keyboard focus indication.
states: The application owns the selected area, profile, available choices, permissions, and empty-state copy.
The card reports popup requests without changing selection or expanded state.
The surface follows the active theme rather than imposing always-dark colors.
responsiveBehavior: The parent owns sticky positioning and shell offsets.
The compact sentence wraps when space is constrained so both controls remain available.

angular: Import the generated standalone adapter; bind controlled labels and expanded states and handle dsScopeRequest.
